title: Adopt landed-changed/ entries: roles stop editing CHANGELOG.md
lead: *Proposed.* Drafted 2026-11-11. ork's side of slicer s453. Once slicer can write and assemble per-item entries under `landed-changed/`, ork's role prompts, docs and checks tell the implementer to write its entry with slicer's command and never edit `CHANGELOG.md`. ork's existing `## Unreleased` entries are converted into `landed-changed/` files. The owner decided on 2026-11-11: slicer owns the format and the assembly, the folder is named `landed-changed`, and converting the existing entries is allowed.
findings_note: Owner 2026-11-11: per-slice changelog files in landed-changed/, owned and assembled by slicer (slicer s453); convert the existing Unreleased entries. Depends on slicer s453 landing.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
*Proposed.* Evidence:

- `CHANGELOG.md` conflicted at landing on S132, S173, S204, S223, S226, S244, S255, S257, S263 and S267 (2026-11-08 to 11-11), because every slice adds a bullet at the top of `## Unreleased`. ork's resolver (`internal/engine/changelog.go:15-18`, called from `internal/engine/landmerge.go:99-105`) patches that; separate entry files remove the conflict.
- slicer 1.22.1 has `slicer changelog add|assemble|import` (slicer s454, landed). A slice writes `landed-changed/ID.md` with `slicer changelog add ID --text TEXT`; `assemble` writes every entry under the Unreleased heading at release and deletes the files; `import` splits an existing Unreleased body into one file per bullet, once (`slicer/docs/commands.md:50`). The feature is off until `changelog_path` is set (`slicer/docs/configuration.md:150`); `changelog_unreleased_heading` defaults to `## [Unreleased]` (`slicer/docs/configuration.md:152`), but ork's heading is `## Unreleased` (`CHANGELOG.md:3`, and `internal/release/changelog_test.go:21-31` requires it).
- ork's role prompts never name `CHANGELOG.md` (`rg -n CHANGELOG internal/roles/prompts` finds nothing, 2026-11-17). The rule lives in the slice specs: 22 open specs besides S332 carry a "CHANGELOG.md: one bullet under `## Unreleased`" step (`slicer find CHANGELOG.md`, 2026-11-17: S221, S233, S240, S249, S250, S251, S261, S318, S335, S355, S374, S380 to S390). The implementer prompt says the brief wins over the prompt (`internal/roles/prompts/implementer.md:8-9`), so the prompt rule must say outright that such a step means `slicer changelog add`.

Owner decisions (2026-11-17, relay session 8d711f67):

- adj 402 (`changelog.convert-timing`): this slice converts ork's Unreleased bullets with `slicer changelog import`, in one commit.
- adj 403 (`changelog.resolver-fate`): the CHANGELOG resolver stays, as the fallback for projects that do not use `landed-changed/`.
- adj 404 (`gate.changelog-entry`): the gate fails a slice with no `landed-changed/ID.md` when the project uses the folder. Under adj 280 (ork does the lifting) ork checks this in Go before the gate role runs; no prompt text carries it.

"The project uses the folder" means the worktree's `slicer config --json` has a non-empty `changelog_path`; the folder is its `changelog_entries_dir`. Not the presence of the folder itself: git keeps no empty folder, and `slicer changelog assemble` deletes every entry file at release, so the folder vanishes after each release.

Import dry run on a scratch copy (2026-11-17, `.scratch/s332/proj`, with `changelog_path` `CHANGELOG.md` and `changelog_unreleased_heading` `## Unreleased`): 43 bullets became `landed-changed/entry-001.md` to `entry-043.md` in body order, Unreleased left empty, everything from `## v1.1.0` down byte-identical. No file is named for an item: ork's bullets start with the ID (`- S379 (*proposed*): ...`), and import names a file only for a bullet that ends with `(ID)` (`slicer/docs/agents.md:632`). `slicer changelog assemble --dry-run` then gives the same 43 bullets with the same text and order; only the blank lines between bullets go (38 in the original body, none after).

Risk: a slice branch started before this lands (the S335 worktree exists at `4ceff329`) still adds a `CHANGELOG.md` bullet. After the import empties Unreleased on main, its landing merge conflicts and the resolver cannot merge it (main no longer has the base entries, `internal/engine/changelog.go:147-165`), so the run pauses for the owner, who moves the bullet into `slicer changelog add ID`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
In `internal/engine/changelog_test.go`, on the engine harness (`newHarness`, item `S04`), each with a test route for `slicer config --json --root W` placed before the default one:

- `TestGateFailsWithoutTheChangelogEntryWhenTheProjectUsesTheFolder`: config `{"changelog_path":"CHANGELOG.md","changelog_entries_dir":"landed-changed"}` and no file `W/landed-changed/S04.md`. Expected: `h.runner.roles()` holds no `gate-N` entry; the run dir holds `changelog-entry-1.md` with exactly

  ```text
  VERDICT: FAIL

  The changelog entry landed-changed/S04.md is missing. This project keeps one changelog entry per slice in landed-changed/ (adj 404). Write it with `slicer changelog add S04 --text "..."`, adding `--category NAME` when `slicer config changelog_categories` lists any. Do not edit CHANGELOG.md.
  ```

  and the round-2 implementer brief has a `## Gate FAIL` section that contains `landed-changed/S04.md`. Once the round limit is reached the run pauses with pending kind `rounds` and a reason that contains `gate failed (changelog entry landed-changed/S04.md is missing)`. Red first: today the gate role runs (`gate-1` is in `roles()`) and no such file is written.
- `TestGateRunsWhenTheChangelogEntryExists`: the same config, and the test writes `W/landed-changed/S04.md` (`entry text\n`) before `h.start()`. Expected: `gate-1` is in `roles()`, the run dir has no `changelog-entry-*.md`, and the run reaches `awaiting-approval`. Red first: it fails to compile until `changelogEntry` exists (the test calls it directly to assert `on == true` and `path == "landed-changed/S04.md"`).
- `TestGateSkipsTheChangelogCheckWhenTheFolderIsOff`: config `{"changelog_path":"","changelog_entries_dir":"landed-changed"}`, no entry file. Expected: `gate-1` runs and the run reaches `awaiting-approval`. Red first: the same compile failure (it asserts `changelogEntry` returns `on == false`).
- `TestGateChangelogConfigReadFailurePauses`: the config route exits 1 with stderr `config unavailable`. Expected: pending kind `error`, state `gate`, and the reason starts with `changelog entry check: `; no gate role ran. Red first: today the gate role runs.

In `internal/engine/filescope_test.go`:

- `TestGateBriefDoesNotFlagTheItemsChangelogEntry`: Files paths `["internal/engine"]`, status ` M internal/engine/check.go\x00?? landed-changed/S04.md\x00?? landed-changed/S05.md\x00`, the entry file present and the folder on. Expected: the gate brief's `## Out of scope files` section lists `landed-changed/S05.md` and not `landed-changed/S04.md`. Red first: today both are listed.

In `internal/roles/roles_test.go` (prompt test, beside `TestImplementerSteps`):

- `TestImplementerPromptWritesTheChangelogEntryWithSlicer`: the implementer prompt contains `slicer changelog add {{slice_id}} --text`, `slicer config changelog_path` and `never edit the changelog file`, and no prompt in `prompts(t)` contains `CHANGELOG.md`. Red first: the first three strings are absent (the last assertion is a guard; it is green today).

In `internal/release/changelog_test.go`:

- `TestUnreleasedHoldsNoBullets`: no line between `## Unreleased` and the next `## ` heading of `CHANGELOG.md` starts with `- `; the failure names the first such line. Red first: 43 bullets stand there today (`CHANGELOG.md:5` onward).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Tests first. Add the default route `slicer config --json --root W` -> `{"changelog_path":"","changelog_entries_dir":"landed-changed"}` to `internal/engine/harness_test.go` beside the `implement_finish` route (line 272), so every existing gate test keeps the folder off. Write the Failing tests and watch each fail for the stated reason.
2. `internal/engine/changelog.go`: add `func (e *Engine) changelogEntry(ctx context.Context, rec runrec.Record) (path string, on bool, err error)`. It calls `e.d.Slicer.ConfigAll(ctx, rec.Worktree)` once and decodes `changelog_path` and `changelog_entries_dir` (a missing key is `""`, so a slicer older than 1.22 reads as off; an empty dir means `landed-changed`). `on` is `changelog_path != ""`; `path` is `DIR/ITEM.md` with forward slashes, for `rec.Item` as given (the case slicer writes). The resolver code in this file stays unchanged (adj 403).
3. `internal/engine/states.go` `gate`: after the slice checks are green (line 890) and before `takePending`, call `changelogEntry`. An error pauses: `runrec.Pending{Kind: runrec.PendingError, State: runrec.StateGate, Reason: "changelog entry check: " + err.Error()}`. With `on` and no regular file at `filepath.Join(rec.Worktree, path)`, write `changelog-entry-ROUND.md` (mode 0o600) in the run dir with the text in Failing tests, then `return e.bumpRound(ctx, runrec.Feedback{Kind: "fail", File: name}, "changelog entry "+path+" is missing")`. No gate role runs, no `slicer note` is written and `fails` is not counted: ork, not the gate role, found it (adj 404 under adj 280).
4. `internal/engine/filescope.go` `scopeSection`: when `changelogEntry` reports `on` without error, append `path` to the allowed list before `ScopeWarnings`; on an error keep today's behaviour (the section is advisory). `ScopeWarnings` itself does not change.
5. `internal/roles/prompts/implementer.md`: after step 9 add the rule, as its own sentence: when `slicer config changelog_path` is set, write this slice's one changelog entry with `slicer changelog add {{slice_id}} --text "..."` (Markdown, no leading bullet; `--category NAME` when `slicer config changelog_categories` lists any; `--replace` to rewrite it), and never edit the changelog file, even when the slice's spec says to add a bullet to it. Do not write the file name `CHANGELOG.md` in any prompt. Owner decision Q-A (adj 445): no sweep of old specs; this rule covers them.
6. Convert ork, in this order, each through slicer: `slicer config changelog_path CHANGELOG.md --root R`, `slicer config changelog_unreleased_heading "## Unreleased" --root R`, `slicer config changelog_require_entry true --root R` (slicer's own `handoff` and `land` warning, `slicer/docs/configuration.md:154`), then `slicer changelog import --root R` (one `landed-changed/entry-NNN.md` file per Unreleased bullet, 53 on 2026-11-18; `## Unreleased` left empty; adj 402), then this slice's own entry: `slicer changelog add S332 --text "..."`. Never edit `CHANGELOG.md` or an entry file by hand.
7. Docs (*proposed*, citing adj 402 to 404):
   - `AGENTS.md` Editing: one bullet: a slice's changelog entry is written with `slicer changelog add ID --text "..."` into `landed-changed/ID.md`; never edit `CHANGELOG.md`; a spec step that says "CHANGELOG.md: one bullet" means this command (adj 404).
   - `docs/release.md`: before the owner writes the `## vX.Y.Z (YYYY-MM-DD)` section, run `slicer changelog assemble` (it fills `## Unreleased` and deletes the entry files); `--dry-run` previews it.
   - `docs/design.md` gate (after line 842): a *Proposed (S332)* paragraph on the entry check (the config switch, the file name, the `fail` feedback, the pause on a config error, the scope exemption). At line 938: the resolver is the fallback for a project with `changelog_path` empty (adj 403).
8. Run `go vet ./...`, `go test ./...`, `gofmt -l .`, `slicer check`, `adj lint`. Mutation-check: delete the `gate` call to `changelogEntry` (the first test goes green-to-red), and drop the `on` test (the off test goes red).
9. Not a UI slice: no `internal/tui`, golden view or CLI output change.

**Not in this slice:** a one-time `slicer edit` sweep of the 22 open specs (Q-A); removing the CHANGELOG resolver (adj 403); a check that fails a diff which edits `CHANGELOG.md` (the import in this very slice edits it); `slicer changelog assemble` and the next release section; slivers' entry policy beyond the run's own item (Q-B).

Owner decisions (2026-11-18): How should this slice's two rg Check lines be run? -> orchestrator: assign both rg lines to the orchestrator; each exits 0 when the string is present.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:

- With 'changelog_path' set in the worktree's slicer config and no 'landed-changed/ITEM.md', the gate role does not run; the implementer gets a 'Gate FAIL' brief that names the missing file and the 'slicer changelog add' command.
- With the entry present, or with 'changelog_path' empty, the gate runs as today.
- A failed 'slicer config --json' read pauses the run in state 'gate' with a reason that starts 'changelog entry check: '.
- The item's own entry file never shows in the gate's out-of-scope warning.
- The implementer prompt tells the role to write its entry with 'slicer changelog add' and never to edit the changelog file; no role prompt names 'CHANGELOG.md'.
- ork's 'CHANGELOG.md' has an empty '## Unreleased', everything from '## v1.1.0' down is unchanged, and 'landed-changed/' holds one 'entry-NNN.md' file per bullet the import found (53 on 2026-11-18, when main held 53 Unreleased bullets) plus 'S332.md'. 'slicer changelog assemble --dry-run' prints those old bullets in their old order plus this slice's.
- The CHANGELOG resolver and its tests are unchanged (adj 403).
- 'AGENTS.md', 'docs/release.md' and 'docs/design.md' describe the above.

Commands:

- `go vet ./...` exits 0.
- `go test ./...` exits 0.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `go test ./internal/engine ./internal/roles ./internal/release` exits 0.
- `slicer changelog assemble --dry-run --root .` exits 0.
- `slicer changelog import --dry-run --root .` exits 0.
- `rg -n "slicer changelog add" internal/roles/prompts/implementer.md AGENTS.md docs/design.md` exits 0.
- `rg -n "slicer changelog assemble" docs/release.md` exits 0.
- `git diff --exit-code HEAD -- internal/engine/landmerge.go` exits 0.
- `slicer check` and `adj lint` exit 0.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
S332: Changelog entries in landed-changed/; roles stop editing CHANGELOG.md

One commit (adj 402): the code, the docs, the slicer config, the import of every Unreleased bullet (53 on 2026-11-18) and this slice's own entry land together.
